## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run type-check` with **0 errors**
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run lint` with **0 errors and 0 warnings**
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run build` and verified the build succeeds
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `/docs` if necessary
- [ ] My changes generate no new security or console warnings
